label: models/fw_console.mdl: a control console, waist high, dials, two screens, a row of switches

measured.lineup: ours is one of A to D in lineup.png beside models/hvr.mdl, models/crystal.mdl, models/big_rock.mdl: the judge does not know which

M1.reason: The outline is a plain box with a thin dark lid overhanging slightly. The brief asks for a control console, which normally has a sloped control face, and nothing in the silhouette suggests a desk. The six views agree with each other, and nothing sticks out or is missing.

M2.reason: The height is 40 units, as the brief's waist-high figure asks, and the measurement shows 0 off. The brief gives no length or width, so the 64 by 40 footprint is accepted as the measured size.

M3.reason: Everything the brief names is present: two green screens, a row of six switches and four orange dials, plus a hazard stripe along the base. The dials are small square blocks, not round dials, and the screens are flat slabs with no bezel, so the shapes are off.

M4.reason: Painted grey steel body, dark steel top, green screen faces, orange dials and yellow-black hazard paint. These suit the Half-Life palette the brief asks for and read as distinct regions of the right materials.

M5.reason: The front face is a fairly flat grey with only the hazard stripe and a few edge highlights. There are no panel lines, labels, rivets or wear marks on the control face, so the 'control panel with dials' reads as bare.

M6.reason: In the line-up it reads as a clean, generic box with flat textures. Half-Life's own props of this size carry more surface detail and modelling, so a player would likely notice it is not one of the game's.

M7.reason: The controls face the viewer in the front view, the console stands upright on its base, and the hazard stripe sits at the bottom where a floor-standing console would have it. Nothing in the pictures shows it lying or floating.

M8.reason: The check errors list is empty. The model has 24 triangles, far under twice the median of 105 for Half-Life props of this size. The side, top and underside views show no open or inside-out faces, and nothing floats.
